functions.label: entry + read + printf
functions.role: main: reads up to 1 MiB from stdin into .bss buffer at 0x104040, calls the core, printf "%016llx" of the 64-bit result

functions.label: checksum_update loop
functions.role: core: h = 0xCBF29CE484222325; per byte: h ^= b; h = rotl64(h, 5); h += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; h ^= h >> 29

algorithm: Reads all of stdin. Initialises a 64-bit state h = 0xCBF29CE484222325 (the FNV-1a offset basis). For each input byte b: h ^= b; h = rotl64(h, 5); h += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 (the golden-ratio constant, as seen in movabs at 0x1011b6); h ^= h >> 29. Prints h as 16 lowercase hex digits and a newline. Always exits 0. The -O2 decompile of the loop looks degenerate (Ghidra reduced it to pointer arithmetic), but the raw instructions at 0x1011cf-0x1011de show xor/rol $5/lea golden-ratio/shr 29 exactly.
